title: X-Caret System - P. Beddows 2003 (dye-trace sketch)
credits: X-Caret System, X'Caret, Quintana Roo: sketch map of the dye-tracing test (injection site, sampling points A, B, C; Injection Site - A = 90 m, A - B = 210 m, A - C = 310 m), in P. A. Beddows, Cave Hydrogeology of the Caribbean Yucatan Coast (PhD thesis, University of Bristol, 2003), p. 46
unverified: No cenote of the map has a position in the database (the Xcaret sistema's only cave has neither name nor coordinates), and the map is a schematic sketch with no scale bar or north arrow. Placed only by ground features on the satellite - the Plaza Principal building, the caleta's channel and mouth, the heart-shaped lagoon - which the Xcaret park has reshaped since; residuals 10-20 m, possibly 30-50 m off at the ends (the sketch's coast band lies 20-40 m inland of today's shore south of the lagoon).
placementWhy: Free similarity fit on four ground features, none a cenote with a known position (Mapbox satellite and Mapbox Streets' OSM data; Overpass timed out): the walled square at the road's west end on the Plaza Principal courtyard building (11.6 m); B, at the narrow neck of the caleta's stippled north arm, on the north end of the caleta channel's open water (10.4 m); the tip of the land between the caleta channel and the north shore band on the rocky point east of the caleta's mouth, the 1979 map's 'Peninsula tip' ground point (20.4 m); the west tip of the U-shaped arm's west lobe on the west tip of the heart-shaped lagoon (19.5 m). Fit: 0.883 m/px, rotated 0.2 deg. Checks: the small walled square south of the big one lands 5 m from the Juego de pelota building south of Plaza Principal; the tongue of land between the U-shaped arm and the coast band ends 15 m from the rocky point south of the caleta's mouth; the north arm's lobes reach 26 m short of where the creek continuing the caleta north ends under the trees. The road east from the square follows the park's walkway east of Plaza Principal. The drawn routes measure Injection Site - A about 97 m (the map says 90 m), A - B about 170 m (210 m), A - C about 280 m (310 m): the sketch isn't to one scale. The south-west pool lands 30-40 m north of the coast, among the park's buildings: no open water shows there today (the earlier guess of the Rio Subterraneo exit pool for it is dropped). Compared with the unverified 1979 Cueva de Xcaret map (xcaret-1979.json), placed on the same caleta: this map's A lies about 65 m south-west of its cenote de Felipe, and this map's passage north-west of the black building (the 1979 map's Mayan ruins by cenote de los franceses) about 60 m north of cenote de los franceses; both are guesses on park landmarks and nothing is taken from the 1979 map's positions.

trace.why: Not a stick map: each passage is drawn as a narrow double line (its two walls, a few metres apart at the sketch's scale), and the ponds and pools on the passages as outlined stippled water. At this resolution the two walls of a passage often touch, so the walls are traced as the outer edge of the inked band (outlineAreas: the double line closed into one band, its outline = the walls, so each passage keeps its width), the stippled ponds closed harder so their dots fill in and only their shore is drawn. Every passage and pond toward the caleta and the sea is kept: the pond complex at C and the stippled pond east of it, the south-west pool and its tail toward the coast, and the dashed passage from the bend south of A to B (an inferred route, drawn dashed on the map). The caleta (its north arm with B, the island west of B, the U-shaped west arm), the coast, the road, the walled squares, the buildings and ruins and the labels are boxed out: surface features, not cave.

outlineAreas.why: pond complex at C and the stippled pond east of it: stipple filled

symbols.why: No depths, heights, letter codes, flow arrows, 'To ...' pointers or bones on this sketch (only the sampling letters A, B, C, the Injection Site and the distances box, which are kept as entrances / in the credits).
